description: This file defines the DonateController class within the Goteo application's controller namespace. It manages donation-related actions such as selecting an amount, choosing a payment method, processing payments, and handling user data for donations.

classes.name: DonateController
classes.description: Controller class handling donation-related workflows within the Goteo platform.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the controller, sets the theme, and checks if the pool payment feature is active.

methods.name: selectAmountDonateAction
methods.description: Handles the action for selecting the donation amount.

methods.name: selectPaymentMethodDonateAction
methods.description: Handles the action for choosing the payment method for donation.

methods.name: paymentFormDonateAction
methods.description: Manages the display and processing of the donation payment form.

methods.name: completePaymentDonateAction
methods.description: Completes the payment process for a donation, given an investment ID.

methods.name: userDataDonateAction
methods.description: Handles user data input and processing for donations.

methods.name: shareDonateAction
methods.description: Handles sharing or referral actions related to donations.
